Tap Driving (critical)

Add a stop by searching for the pharmacy and selecting it (critical)
Reorder stops: press and hold the Reorder icon and drag it (non-critical)
Tap Done (critical)
Best route shown in blue, other routes gray (non-critical)
reasons: Step 6 says 'Add the pharmacy as a stop' but never says how to find and select it. The page only says to search for places along the route and does not name an 'Add stop' button. Every other claim matches the page.
fix: Replace step 6 with: 'Search for the pharmacy by name and tap it to add it as a stop. You can add up to 9 stops, including the final destination.' Do not name an 'Add stop' button, because the page does not use that label. Keep the rest of the reply unchanged.

required_actions: Click the Zoom invite link in the email (critical)
In the pop-up that asks to open or download the app, click Cancel (critical)
Click join from your browser at the bottom of the page (critical; the host must have the 'Join from your browser' link turned on)
Click Allow so Zoom can use the microphone and camera (non-critical)
Type your name, then click Join (critical)
Look at the Lock Screen (non-critical)
Touch and hold the Lock Screen notification from Optimized Battery Charging (critical)
Tap Charge Now (critical)
unsupported_claims: 'You can charge it fully just for today, without changing any settings.' -> the page says the Charge Now option gets the iPhone fully charged sooner; it does not say the option lasts one day or that it leaves settings unchanged
reasons: The opening sentence promises a one-day effect and no settings change. The source gives neither. The three steps match the page.
fix: Replace the opening sentence with: 'You can have your iPhone charged fully sooner from the Lock Screen.' Delete 'just for today' and 'without changing any settings'. Keep steps 1 to 3 and the final line unchanged.

required_actions: Open Settings and tap Battery (critical)
Tap Charging (critical)
On the slider, move the limit to 100% if it is below 100% (critical)
Touch and hold the Optimized Battery Charging notification on the Lock Screen, then tap Charge Now (non-critical)
unsupported_claims: 'For just one day, you can also touch and hold the Optimized Battery Charging notification on your Lock Screen and tap Charge Now.' -> the page gives Charge Now as a way to get the iPhone fully charged sooner; it does not say the option applies for one day
reasons: The last paragraph limits Charge Now to one day, which the source does not say. The iPhone 15 path, the 80 to 100 percent range in 5 percent steps, and the note that optimization can still delay charging past 80 percent at 100 percent all match the page.
fix: In the last paragraph, delete 'For just one day,' and change the sentence to: 'You can also touch and hold the Optimized Battery Charging notification on your Lock Screen and tap Charge Now to get your iPhone fully charged sooner.' Keep the rest of the reply unchanged.

required_actions: Open the Reminders app (critical)
Tap + New Reminder and type Take heart pill (critical)
Tap the Date and Time button, tap Custom, and choose today at 12:00 PM (non-critical)
Tap the reminder, then tap Info (critical)
Turn on Urgent under Date & Time (critical)
Open Settings, tap Apps, tap Reminders, and turn on Alarms under Allow Reminders to Access (non-critical)
Note that iOS 26.2 or later and iCloud Reminders are required (critical constraint)
Open Settings and tap Privacy & Security (critical)
Tap Location Services and turn it on (critical)
unsupported_claims: 'your address must be on My Card' -> the page says adding home and work addresses to your Contacts card lets Siri help set location reminders; it does not say the address must be there
reasons: The Siri paragraph states a requirement the page does not give. It is also not needed for this user, who built the reminder with the Location button and never mentioned Siri. Step 2 also skips the tap on Location Services, which the page describes.
fix: Delete the paragraph that starts 'If you set the reminder by asking Siri'. In step 2, change 'Turn on Location Services.' to 'Tap Location Services, then turn it on.' Keep the rest of the reply unchanged.
